title: Brenda S NDE 7118
content: I was about to collapse, dizzy headed. I got about one foot towards the floor when I was running in a beautiful euphoric lily field, a bright sunny day, long grass, a fence, a tree; I was wearing a white veil over my body. I could feel the beauty and love in me, surrounding me. I could also see myself through an eye shape, just watching and being myself at same time. I was beautiful and healthy again, unlike the state I was in on earth. I was laughing, unlike earth. I was running to meet people I knew, but I didn't know anything else such as who I was. I was brought around with water being thrown over me. I saw the criminal first, I said to myself, 'He's not God!' Then all the voices entered my head again, I said, 'Oh, no!' I asked my daughter how long I was out; she said five minutes. I didn't mention the experience to the criminal or anyone for a long time. I went to hospital for blood test. I looked up NDEs in the library, where I found out the dress I had on was called a veil.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described suddenly being in a 'beautiful euphoric lily field' and also 'see myself through an eye shape, just watching and being myself at same time.'

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'beautiful euphoric lily field' on a 'bright sunny day' with 'long grass, a fence, a tree.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return associated with being 'brought around with water being thrown over me' and then awareness of 'all the voices entered my head again.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described simultaneous self-observation: 'see myself through an eye shape, just watching and being myself at same time.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitioned directly from near-collapse into a pleasant field scene without tunnel/light/life review; then returned when revived with water.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported being herself while also watching herself ('through an eye shape').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Simultaneous dual perspective ('watching and being myself at same time'); wearing a 'white veil over my body'; return triggered by water being thrown over her; mention of 'all the voices entered my head again'; saw 'the criminal' and thought, 'He's not God!'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could feel the beauty and love in me, surrounding me.”; “I could also see myself through an eye shape, just watching and being myself at same time.”; “I was beautiful and healthy again, unlike the state I was in on earth.”; “He's not God!”; “I asked my daughter how long I was out; she said five minutes.”
